title: LinkedIn is scary...but important 🔎
description:
LinkedIn has a whole bunch of odd perceptions about it but it is incredibly important for landing a new job. When recruiters go and search for candidates for open roles EVERY section of your profile can contribute to you being discovered. From your headline, about me and work experience, make sure each area is packed with hard skills, soft skills and technical keywords that you pull from the job description. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
